why: A claim names a criterion, or it does not, and two languages decide that. synthorg.core.criterion_match.criterion_key refuses the write; web/src/utils/planCoverage.ts::coverageKey decides what the review surface shows as covered. Looser in the browser places a claim the backend rejected; stricter leaves one it accepted reading as uncovered. Both sides key every case below and must agree, so a change to either is a failing test rather than a silent divergence.
